{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend structured blazer, tailored fit, knee-length hem, charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy wool blend.
Cotton-poplin button-down blouse, relaxed collar, hip-length tunic cut, ivory white (#FFFFF0), soft cotton poplin.
Mid-weight merino wool trousers, straight-leg cut, full-length pant leg, slate blue (#2F4F4F), fine-gauge merino wool.
Leather ankle boots with a low block heel, round toe, calf-high shaft, deep black (#000000), smooth calfskin leather.

This ensemble works perfectly for a business meeting in snowy weather because the structured blazer and wool trousers provide essential warmth without looking bulky, while the ivory blouse offers a polished, professional contrast that remains visible even if snow dusts the coat. The block-heel ankle boots offer stability and traction on salted autumn roads during your 20-minute walk, protecting your feet from frost and slush better than open shoes or flats would. Finally, the sophisticated color palette of charcoal, slate, and ivory conveys authority and competence appropriate for a formal work setting, ensuring you feel confident and prepared from the moment you step outside into the snow until you arrive at your destination."}
